what: Intro text lines go from 14px blur and transparent to clear — one progress value fills over 1.2s with 1-(1-t)^4, and each line’s .45-wide window is offset by .55 divided by the line count, so when the previous line is half clear the next one emerges from the blur. When turned off it reverses over .7s — lines blur out starting from the last. Repeats each time it enters and leaves the screen (or whenever the caller adds and removes is-in)

options.spread: Gap between the start of the first and last rows (progress), default .55 — 0 means all at once
options.threshold: How much must be on screen to trigger, default .3
options.look: state: Class is used in place of visible="is-in" Add and remove it to switch on and off (scene text tied to the scroll frame)
options.[data-fx-part=line]: Line rising out of the blur
